comment: The ladder of minds (Glenn 2026-09-18). Height is the rung; two minds at one height are the same rung in two lineages, and sideways comes before up. kinds is the by-KIND designation, never a height: security and a fresh take are Johnny's. lanes are the lanes that mind owns. availability is available | asleep | reserved; a reserved mind is off the height ladder, takes no work, and is reached only by a designation -- which is a READ and a STOP, never the work itself.
floors_comment: The confidence floor PER KIND, measured. One floor for every kind put 13 of 13 provider answers below it on 2026-09-18 (0.70-0.78 against 0.90) and made the step-up universal, which defeats 'the lowest rung the evidence supports'. Each row is the p25 of the answers that stood for that kind, as `nova-decide tune --propose-floors --log <log>` computes it, and `from` is the run it was read off. A kind with NO row keeps the built-in 0.9 -- a floor with no rows behind it, and every line that uses one says floor_from=built-in.

rates_comment: What a model's tokens cost, in US dollars per MILLION tokens, so a usage row carries usd rather than a dash. TypeSafe publishes no rate for jev-latest that we have been given, so the table is empty and every jev usage row is a dash with a NOTE naming the model: a made-up price is worse than an honest absence. Add {"model": "jev-latest", "provider": "typesafe", "input_usd_per_mtok": <n>, "output_usd_per_mtok": <n>, "from": "<where it is published>"} when the rate is known.
